data.narrative:
Boom Supersonic is a Series D stage developer in the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector, founded by Blake Scholl, Joe Wilding, and Josh Krall. The company has raised $600M+ to date and carries a last post-money valuation of $1.5B. The comparable universe for this frontier segment is sparse: two public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and one private comparable (Hermeus) exist within the broader sector.

Peer-median valuation analysis was not applicable due to insufficient data density—the narrow filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints necessary for robust triangulation. Consequently, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Applying a typical Series D to next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.5x to the $1.5B last post-money valuation implies an enterprise value of $2.2B.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $1.9B to $2.6B, with a central estimate of $2.2B. This range reflects a 1.5x progression from current marks. Key uncertainties include the extreme capital intensity of supersonic vehicle development, regulatory pathway clarity for commercial operations, and the absence of sufficient comparable transactions or public trading data to benchmark this nascent sector. Any forward valuation will remain highly contingent on technical milestones and certification progress.
